summary: Trinseo PLC filed a Form 8-K on September 23, 2026, reporting the adjournment of its 2026 annual general meeting and an extraordinary general meeting due to the failure of a quorum, with both reconvened for September 30, 2026. The record dates remain July 30, 2026, for the annual meeting and August 12, 2026, for the EGM. No substantive resolutions are proposed at the EGM. This is a routine procedural and meeting notice filing, devoid of transaction terms, board recommendations, advisors, or structural special-situation mechanics, and therefore does not constitute a special situation.
